description.value: Plates Eatery is a locally owned, automotive-themed diner in Courtenay that has been serving the community since April 2000. It specialises in all-day breakfasts — from classic eggs-and-hash-browns platters to eggs benny, Tex-Mex skillets, and housemade waffles — alongside burgers, homemade soups, schnitzel, and a Thursday/Friday dinner service. A dependable stop on the Vancouver Island cycling corridor offering both dine-in and takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at plateseatery.ca was successfully fetched and corroborates the OSM address (2601 Cliffe Avenue, Courtenay, BC V9N 2L8) and phone number (250-334-8087). The site consistently brands the business as 'Plates Eatery' across all pages and explicitly states 'We are not offering catering services, at this time', making the OSM name 'Plates Eatery & Catering Co.' outdated — the name field is updated to the current website value and the discrepancy flagged. Takeout is directly confirmed by the phrase 'Dine In / Take Out' on the homepage; bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Plates Eatery & Catering Co.' is outdated — website consistently uses 'Plates Eatery' and explicitly states catering is no longer offered; name field updated to website value.
Website copyright footer reads '© 2026 Plates Catering & Eatery' while all page content uses 'Plates Eatery'; footer appears to be a stale artifact rather than the current trading name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, family-owned restaurant in Courtenay confirmed by an active website and a recent OSM check-date of 2025-05-24; a clear include for the cycling tourism directory.
